name: First Kiss or can I keep cool around my crush for even a moment?!
source:
A short visual novel about two magic school students trying to take their minds off an upcoming stressful event.

[From [url=https://blairfujin.itch.io/first-kiss-or-can-i-keep-cool-around-my-crush-for-even-a-moment]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个魔法学校的学生正在想方设法转移注意力，好让自己暂时别去想那件即将到来、令人压力重重的事。这是一部关于他们的短篇视觉小说。
